images.caption: Walkway on the eastern side of the Humber Bridge, England. Look closely at the photo - you will see the arch in the walkway and road as you head towards the centre of the bridge. You can also see some of the strange attachments to the suspending wires, believed to have been added to stop resonation in the cables during high winds (which happens often on the Humber).

images.caption: A bucket of mud Discarded metal bucket in the mud below the high water mark at Barton-upon-Humber, Lincolnshire, England.Behind the camera are the ruins of the William Blyth Tileworks established in the 19th century. West of the tileworks, the old brick ponds have now become the Far Ings National Nature Reserve and an outdoor pursuits centre. Not much more to say, really. The A15 passes by here somewhere.

images.filename: Ferens Art Gallery at Night - geograph.org.uk - 1560622.jpg
images.caption: Ferens Art Gallery at Night Ferens Art Gallery is situated in Victoria square in Hull.  The area is illuminated by high pressure sodium lighting which gives rise to this weird effect.  Superficially, it looks as though the square was deserted, but the long exposure has 'lost' the people as none were standing still at the time!
images.alt: Ferens Art Gallery at Night Ferens Art Gallery is situated in Victoria square in Hull.  The area is illuminated by high pressure sodium lighting which gives rise to this weird effect.  Superficially, it looks as though the square was deserted, but the long exposure has 'lost' the people as none were standing still at the time!
categories: Images from Geograph Britain and Ireland

images.caption: Fountain in Princes Quay Princes Quay is a shopping complex in the centre of Hull and is built on 'stilts' above the former Princes Dock.  There are two fountains in the dock now and this is the most northerly one.  The shopping centre itself can be seen in the background.  The photograph was taken with an exposure time of about six seconds to give this effect.
images.alt: Fountain in Princes Quay Princes Quay is a shopping complex in the centre of Hull and is built on 'stilts' above the former Princes Dock.
